text: This report provides a summary and analysis of grievance and arbitration activity for the six (6) month period of July 1, 2017 to December 31, 2017. The 2017 grievance activity is also compared to the six (6) month period from July 1 , 2016 to December 31, 2016. In the last six (6) months of 2017, the total number of grievances filed by all bargaining units on Exhibition Place grounds was sixteen (16). Of the sixteen (16) grievances filed, zero are at arbitration. During the same time period in 2016, the total number of grievances filed by all bargaining units was fourteen (14).
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place received the report (March 1, 2018) from the Director, Employee and Labour Relations for information.
